name: Kim Vaillancourt
duties: Fulfills the responsibilities assigned in USA Gymnastics Rules & Policies, attends required regional and national functions, manages state finances, conducts committee votes, approves and publishes the state schedule, tracks qualification and mobility scores, receives state championship bids, oversees host selection, serves as the official USAG state representative at State Championships or appoints a designee, and works with the webmaster to maintain the website and send membership notices.
